notes: What each brand says about its fuels: commercial name and the additive claims it makes, per fuel field of the official API. These are marketing statements, summarised from the linked page on the date given; nothing here is verified, and nothing says a given station actually sells that formulation. A brand/fuel that is missing simply has no researched claim. Shared by the Android app (FuelProducts) and the web.

baseline.en: Every road petrol and diesel sold in Spain meets EN 228 / EN 590 (Real Decreto 61/2006); brands add their own additive packages on top.
baseline.es: Toda gasolina y gasóleo de automoción vendido en España cumple EN 228 / EN 590 (Real Decreto 61/2006); cada marca añade encima su propio paquete de aditivos.
